You use plugins to modify the MV's default behavior. older engines called them scripts, but MV/Z calls them plugins. Script within MV/Z generally refers to the little bits of javascript you manually run through script boxes from event commands
that being said. you can give this a shot.
Custom Game Over behavior
Custom Game Over      Version 1.3.2      by McKathlin   Introduction     Change what happens when the party dies or an event calls Game Over processing.         In some games, after the party dies they find themselves in a recently visited safe place, where they can continue their game with all...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
See if you can get it to play a common event to take the player to the afterlife area instead of issuing a game over

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Okay, first you make that after-life map, like any other map.
Now, when you trigger the boss battle in an event, check "can lose".
Now, in the event, you see there is 2 spaces below, one where you can put what happens when you win, and one where you can put what happens when you lose, instead of the game-over screen.
In that last space, you create a transfer to the after-life map.
